drafts.title: Clash of Approaches
drafts.reasoning: This scene focuses on the conflict between two contrasting characters—Hank, the gruff police captain, and John, the principled rookie officer—with Noel maintaining an unspoken presence in the background.
drafts.scene: The office is dimly lit by the late afternoon light, casting long shadows across the cluttered desks. Papers are scattered everywhere. Two chairs sit awkwardly in one corner, where a presentation about the ongoing investigation into a series of arson cases is set up. John has just arrived, carrying a bag filled with snacks, which he places beside him with a smirk.

dialogue.line: Alright, kid, what do you think you’re doing? This isn’t some classroom lecture.
I’m trying to be thorough, sir. And it helps if we have something to snack on during the tedious part.
We don't need your condescending humor here. Stick to the facts.
Facts can get boring without a little flavor, right?
You're lucky I'm not making this easy for the brass to move you along.
Oh, come on! You know me better than that.
Tell me why I should believe anything you say then, if all you care about is doughnuts and your own ass.
Hey, at least my sugar intake keeps me sharp. And who knows, maybe one day you’ll appreciate snacks too.
